svg.title: NET-10 — All active sessions browser
svg.desc: NET-10-results. The canvas origin is (25,20); SVG coordinates use the top-left origin. Production bottom-left allocations: unchanged heading (28,490), 794 by 20; taller list body (28,248), 794 by 242, ten rows at the unchanged 22 px pitch; read-only detail border (28,108), 794 by 128, with 8 px inner padding and a 12 px list gap. Remove Ready empty session. Your role is confirmed only after admission. and The host confirms availability when you connect. without replacement in the browser only. Keep full selected identity, mode, endpoint, necessary reasons and ongoing context inside the border. Compact upper Refresh remains (710,518), 112 by 24; its focus/status clearance is unchanged under UX-NET-10-042. UX-NET-10-008 lowers the single footer row by 40 px: Join selected (28,28), Direct connect (296,28), Back (564,28), each 252 by 32 with 16 px gaps. Conditional paging also moves down 40 px to y=68, retaining widths, centered current-page label and hidden-input rules. Forward focus remains Refresh, table, Previous, Next, Join selected, Direct connect, Back, Refresh; reverse reverses this cycle and both skip hidden or disabled controls. UX-NET-10-043/045 retain protected ongoing Started/Open eligibility and next-round context; UX-NET-10-044 pairs the selection with genuinely completed Closed. Discovery, binding, admission, stale inspection and recovery behavior remain unchanged. Dedicated idle keeps Idle, 0 / limit and actual admission eligibility without claiming a controller.

g.text: Session: full session identity • Mode: Predator
Match in progress. Your players join next round if admitted.
Ten visible rows; headings stay fixed. Conditional paging uses y=68 above the lowered footer.
Stale: Join selected disabled; show Refresh before joining. Direct connect stays independent.

Closed row: completed match. Status/paging stay reserved; unavailable page direction disabled.
